name: GATE Overflow CS Test Series 2025 | Verbal Aptitude 1

question.text:
When she first came to Delhi from Patna, she was hardly the $\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_$ student she later made herself out to be, since she had access to considerable family wealth.
    
  1. impecunious
  2. naive
  3. precocious
  4. ambitious

From among the given sentences pick the grammatically correct one.
      

  1. She was prevented to come.
  2. Ravi met misfortune.
  3. We came a walk.
  4. Let’s go riding.

Fact: If it's cooked, the food is soft.
Which of the following is a logically valid conclusion based on the above argument?

  1. It is cooked.
  2. The food is not soft.
  3. The food is soft.
  4. It is not cooked.

    1. If (III), then (IV).
    2. If (I), then (II).
    3. If (IV), then (II).
    4. If (II), then (IV).

If you are absent from class for too long, it will be difficult to $\_\_\_\_$ .
     

  1. catch up
  2. catch out
  3. catch on
  4. catch at

Which of the following cannot be logically inferred from the given passage?

Coronavirus disease (COVID-19) is an infectious disease caused by a newly discovered coronavirus.

Most people infected with the COVID-19 virus will experience mild to moderate respiratory illness and recover without requiring special treatment.  Older people, and those with underlying medical problems like cardiovascular disease, diabetes, chronic respiratory disease, and cancer are more likely to develop serious illness.

The COVID-19 virus spreads primarily through droplets of saliva or discharge from the nose when an infected person coughs or sneezes, so it’s important that you also practice respiratory etiquette.

  1. Most corona virus affected patients recover without special care.
  2. COVID-19 is severe on older people.
  3. COVID-19 is not dangerous if you are young.
  4. Maintaining hygiene helps in controlling COVID-19 spread.

The topic that we were discussing now was first raised by our boss, $\_\_\_\_\_\_$?

  1. isn't it
  2. wasn't it
  3. was it
  4. hasn't it been

Fill in the blank with the most appropriate choice.

Akshay has decided to $\_\_\_\_\_\_\_$ from Chennai.
 

  1. move on
  2. pass away
  3. pass out
  4. pass by

The Prime Minister does not approve $\_\_\_\_\_\_$ the views expressed by the official.

  1. of
  2. at
  3. for
  4. on

Choose the most appropriate alternative from the options given below to complete the sentence:

The bride and groom decided to _________  on their grand wedding as they both were rich.
 

  1. preserve
  2. conserve
  3. spoor
  4. splurge

Fill in the blank with the most appropriate word:
The house $\_\_\_\_$ the lake.
     

  1. backed onto
  2. backed off
  3. backed up
  4. backed into

Choose from the options the word most similar in meaning to the given one:

Dramatic
 

  1. striking
  2. insignificant
  3. calm
  4. tedious

Choose the most appropriate alternative from the options given below to complete the sentence:

Killing one's own parents amounts to __________.
 

  1. parricide
  2. genocide
  3. infanticide
  4. fratricide

From among the given sentences pick the grammatically INCORRECT one:

  1. He asked a tea.
  2. He was prevented from coming.
  3. I met your mother.
  4. I haven't seen a movie for a long time.

$\_\_\_\_\_\_$ I not informed you on time, you would have missed the opportunity.

  1. But
  2. Have
  3. Had
  4. Has

From among the given sentences pick the grammatically correct one:
      

  1. I'm ill for two weeks.
  2. I'm ill since two weeks.
  3. I have been ill since two weeks.
  4. I have been ill for two weeks.

The disaster team  was asked to $\underline{\text{restrain}}$ the residents until the snake was caught.

The underlined word is closest in meaning to:

  1. imprison
  2. frustrate
  3. disdain
  4. confine

A $\underline{vast}$ crowd had gathered to watch their $\underline{beloved}$ Prime Minister speak. The underlined words are $\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_$.
    
  1. adverbs
  2. nouns
  3. verbs
  4. adjectives

Choose the most appropriate alternative from the options given below to complete the sentence:
    
Anwar spent most of his life in $\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_$ the miseries of the physically challenged people.
    
  1. advocating
  2. avoiding
  3. mitigating
  4. absorbing

Choose the most appropriate tense and fill in the blank:
Tom $\_\_\_\_$ to the day when he could leave his current job.
  1. should've looked forward
  2. to look forward
  3. looking forward
  4. looked forward

If "jelogo" means "paperweight" and "pikogo" means "paperboard" and "wedpik" means "boardlift", which of the following would mean $weightlift$?

  1. ogopik
  2. jelwed
  3. pikjel
  4. wedjel

Choose from the options the word most similar in meaning to the given one:
Impulsive
 

  1. impetuous
  2. cautious
  3. cavernous
  4. impressive

In the following sentence certain parts are underlined and marked P, Q, and R. One of the parts may contain certain error or may not be acceptable in standard written communication. Select the part containing an error. Choose D as your answer if there is no error.

During an epidemic, if organizations provide $\underbrace{\underline{\text{flexibility to employees to work from}}}_{P}$  $\underbrace{\underline{\text{home, it would}}}_{Q}$ $\underbrace{\underline{\text{make them more comfortable}}}_{R}$.
 

  1. P
  2. Q
  3. R
  4. No error

1. Kevin is older than Tim.
  2. Jason is older than Kevin.
  3. Tim is older than Jason.

If the statements (I) and (II) are TRUE, then (III) will be:

  1. Insufficient data
  2. True
  3. Not applicable
  4. False

The questions given below consist of a pair of related words followed by four pairs of words. Select the pair that best expresses the relation to the original pair.
Doctor: Treatment
  1. Scientist: Research
  2. Lawyer: Court
  3. Nurse: Health
  4. Dancer: Stage

From among the given sentences pick the grammatically INCORRECT one:
      

  1. I'm going to home.
  2. Send this letter to my address.
  3. They came for driving.
  4. He goes to his work.

From among the given sentences pick the grammatically correct one:
      

  1. Hugging his mother he opened the gift box.
  2. His performance in the match was superior than his teammates.
  3. I saw them playing while driving down the street.
  4. Laughing out loud Teja tried to express his happiness.

Choose the most appropriate alternative from the options given below to complete the sentence:
    
Your allegation should be based on facts and not on $\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_$.
    
  1. proofs
  2. projections
  3. records
  4. antipathy

Fill in the blank with the most appropriate word:
After a long and hard relationship, he finally decided to $\_\_\_\_$ with his girlfriend.

     

  1. break in
  2. break off
  3. broke up
  4. break up

The questions given below consist of a pair of related words followed by four pairs of words. Select the pair that best expresses the relation to the original pair.
Epileptology: Neurology

  1. Psychiatry: Pathology
  2. Neonatology: Paediatrics
  3. Hematology: Orthopedics
  4. Neurology: Nephrology

If YLNDNN stands for 'one and only' and BTTL stands for 'let it be', which of the following stands for 'dream about me'?
  1. MTUMRD
  2. MTBMRD
  3. MTBERD
  4. MTBMAD
